purpose: Check one pre-action opportunity sampling change using already collected data, before fitting any service model.
input: Current server-resident v120 contexts, native service logs, and immutable original latest5 packet selection.
one_change: For each original packet, keep latest5 if it already contains an opportunity. Otherwise replace only its oldest selected root with the latest time-eligible opportunity root in the same release window; at most1 replacement per packet. If none exists, keep original5.
opportunity_predicate: At issue, exists feeder with next_stop_matches=true and current_leg_dest_count>0. Do not require a diagnostic person or known future transfer. Do not require same_lane; its undefined cross-lane gap stays missing.
selection_inputs: Current context, original maturity clock and sequence only; never actual boarding, later costs, passenger IDs, or outcome-ranked lines/windows.
output: In a new isolated directory compare opportunity coverage, positive connection labels, maturity and duplicates; keep original selection/results unchanged. This is an exposed-data coverage check, not independent validation or a new control candidate.
decision: If the fixed predicate still yields no positive connection examples, stop this sampling candidate; no automatic quota2/window/dose changes. Positive coverage only permits defining a separate learning/validation contract, not automatic training or control deployment.
grouping: Shared prefix and same-root records stay in one group; no random row split across training/validation.
cost_gate: Complete four days and technical checks. fresh-minus-matched-no_fresh mean<0,stable<=0,shock<0; additionally fresh-minus-same-actor-frozen<=0 in each scenario and at least one<0. Report no_fresh-minus-frozen to distinguish baseline drift. Early and tail windows are descriptive, not new gates.
